outcome: Help operational leaders anticipate demand and coordinate beds, theatres, diagnostics and staffing without compromising clinical priority or workforce rules.
overview: Demand, discharge barriers, theatre lists and nursing rosters are planned in separate systems and separate meetings, so hospitals board patients in corridors while beds sit blocked and premium staffing absorbs the gap. This solution reconciles ADT, theatre, diagnostic, roster and facilities data into one operational model, forecasts demand by ward and specialty, and proposes bed, theatre and staffing plans that respect clinical priority, skill mix and labour rules as hard constraints. Planners approve or reject every plan, overrides are recorded, and balancing safety measures are reported alongside financial ones. An 8–14-week proof of value targets a 10% reduction in selected boarding or avoidable bed-delay hours.

benefits.text: Reduce selected boarding or avoidable bed-delay hours by a target 10%
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Target to validate against the customer’s own reconciled ADT timestamps during the proof of value — not a guarantee

benefits.text: Improve demand-forecast accuracy and theatre and diagnostic utilisation on the piloted site
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Accuracy depends on timestamp completeness and how consistently bed and status definitions are applied; measured against a back-test and a controlled operational trial

benefits.text: Reduce premium and agency staffing spend without worsening the agreed safety balancing measures
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Savings are only counted once finance confirms them; safety balancing measures are reported alongside and a deterioration halts the claim — optimisation never overrides clinical prioritisation

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); operational and patient-identifiable data stay in the customer tenancy in the reference designs, in line with UAE and Saudi health-data regulations

notFor.situation: ADT and theatre timestamps are unreliable or bed statuses are recorded inconsistently
notFor.why: Forecasts and optimisation inherit the quality of the timestamps; an unreconciled feed produces confident plans that operational teams will correctly ignore

notFor.situation: Expectation of autonomous bed or staffing decisions without a planner approving them
notFor.why: Clinical prioritisation stays with clinicians and planners; the source catalogue is explicit that optimisation does not replace clinical prioritisation, and unapproved automation is unsafe and industrially contentious

notFor.situation: No single accountable command-centre or flow owner across wards, theatres and workforce
notFor.why: Cross-silo plans need one authority to accept trade-offs; without it recommendations stall between departments

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns clinical prioritisation, labour-rule definition and plan approval · Duration: 8–14-week proof of value; 16–28 weeks to scaled deployment
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, data engineer, operations-research analyst, integration engineer; customer command-centre lead, bed manager, workforce lead, EHR and rostering integration leads, privacy and security approvers · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Flow discovery and timestamp reconciliation
2) Operational model build and forecast back-test
3) Constraint encoding with clinical and workforce sign-off
4) Command-centre workflow build and planner UAT
5) Controlled operational trial with daily huddles
6) Stabilisation, finance-confirmed benefit review and handover
deliverables: Operational timestamps reconcile with the source ADT, theatre and roster systems
Forecast and constraint tests pass on agreed historical periods
No plan can be released without recorded planner approval, and every override is captured
Safety balancing measures are reported and show no deterioration attributable to the trial
Downtime and security tests passed; planners complete operational UAT and finance confirms the baseline
